### [![SegarKosan](https://img.shields.io/badge/SegarKosan-Repository-00599C?style=for-the-badge&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/SegarKosan)
> **Smart Kosan with Odor Detection**


An IoT-based air quality monitoring system designed for student boarding rooms (kos-kosan). Uses ESP32-C3 with DHT22 and MQ-135 sensors to monitor temperature, humidity, CO2 levels, and calculate a real-time odor score (0-100). Features OLED display, web dashboard with historical graphs, and smart alert notifications.
